run_learn_dynamics_iiwa: run the KUKA iiwa inverse dynamics learning example with configurable epochs and data size
create_NMSELoss: create a normalized mean squared error loss function that weights errors by variance
use_DifferentiableRobotModel: use a differentiable robot model to make link parameters like mass and inertia learnable
generate_sine_motion_data: generate sine motion inverse dynamics training data from a ground truth robot model
compute_inverse_dynamics: compute inverse dynamics torque predictions from joint positions, velocities, and accelerations
